title: Identify predicate-modifying adverbs
phenomenon: Use the installed UniDic-CWJ 202512 analysis to find every token whose primary UniDic part of speech is exactly 副詞. Do not infer the category from syntactic use: exclude nouns and adjectival nouns even when they modify a predicate. Label each selected token adverb.
sentences: 彼はおよそ三時間待った。
彼は一層慎重になった。
結果はかなり良かった。

title: Align repeated nouns with subject marking
phenomenon: Using the installed UniDic-CWJ 202512 segmentation, find each analyzer token whose primary and secondary UniDic parts of speech are exactly 名詞 and 普通名詞 and whose next analyzer token is the subject particle が. Span only that common-noun token; do not merge adjacent prefixes or suffixes. Label it ga_marked_subject.
sentences: 研究者が研究を続けた。
oracle_query: ga_marked_subject := [unidic.pos1=名詞 & unidic.pos2=普通名詞] followed_by([text=が]).

title: Extract complete obligation predicates
phenomenon: Find complete predicates expressing obligation with either plain なければならない or its polite inflection なければなりません. Include the lexical predicate and the full obligation inflection. Exclude other necessity constructions such as 必要がある. Label each selected span obligation_predicate.
sentences: 申請書を提出しなければならない。
今すぐ帰らなければなりません。
許可を得る必要がある。

targets.surface: 提出しなければならない
targets.label: obligation_predicate

targets.surface: 帰らなければなりません
targets.label: obligation_predicate

title: Disambiguate grammatical functions of no
phenomenon: Find clause-following の in either of two constructions. Label it nominalizer when the clause is nominalized and followed by a particle, or explanatory_no when it is followed by the copula だ/です and presents the clause as an explanation. Exclude noun-linking adnominal/genitive の.
sentences: 料理を作るのは楽しい。
oracle_query:
nominalizer := [text=の & unidic.pos2=準体助詞] followed_by([text in {は, が, を, も, か}]).
explanatory_no := [text=の & unidic.pos2=準体助詞] followed_by([unidic.pos1=助動詞]).

title: Separate passive predicates from active and intransitive forms
phenomenon: Find complete predicates carrying passive voice, including the lexical predicate and passive inflection. Label them passive_predicate. Exclude active predicates, lexically intransitive change-of-state predicates, and られる forms whose contextual reading is potential rather than passive.
sentences: 計画は委員会で承認された。
彼は先生に褒められた。
委員会が計画を承認した。
目覚ましのおかげで、私は今朝六時に起きられた。
oracle_query: lexicon passive_predicate by [text] := {"承認された", "褒められた", "斬られた", "奪われた", "投げられた", "遭わされる", "取られぬ", "接収された", "追いやられてしまった", "返還される"}.

title: Author a reusable sentence-final epistemic query
phenomenon: Apply one reusable extraction rule across the full sentence set. Find complete epistemic stance expressions immediately before sentence-final punctuation. Label だろう as conjecture, かもしれない as possibility, and に違いない as strong_inference. Do not emit the same forms when embedded before a following quotative or matrix clause.
sentences: 結果は同じかもしれない。
彼が来るだろうと私は考えた。
oracle_query:
conjecture := [text=だろう] followed_by([upos=PUNCT] $).
possibility := [text=か] [text=も] [text=しれ] [text=ない] followed_by([upos=PUNCT] $).
strong_inference := [text=に] [text=違い] [text=ない] followed_by([upos=PUNCT] $).

sentences: 彼は来るかもしれないと述べた。
たぶん彼も来るだろう。
